samples.question: Among the adults conducted the survey on April 25 - May 1 2018, how many adults rated Trump's government ethical standards as poor?

According to the survey on April 25 - May 1, 2018, what are the domains with the highest percentage that adults are very confident and not at all confident of Donald Trump's govenment? Please write the answer in the list format and with alphabetical order, e.g., ["A","B"]
samples.pred: ["Handle an international crisis", "Make good appointments to the federal courts", "Make wise decisions about immigration policy", "Manage the executive branch effectively", "Negotiate favorable trade agreements with other countries", "Use military force wisely", "Work effectively with Congress"]
